build.notes: Upstream is a .NET desktop app. This directory publishes rendered documentation, screenshots, and the design mockup. In-site URLs are relative so GitHub Pages serves them under /filee/.

accessCode.howToUse: Upstream README, configuration, and build scripts do not reference HTQGP2E. Open /filee/ directly; the page has no prompt. The value is recorded here so this deployment can be matched to the supplied code.
